game.title: Darksiders

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). This entry uses the Steam app for Darksiders Warmastered Edition (462780), the edition on sale; the original "Darksiders™" app (50620) is still listed with the same 43 achievements, but its schema name is a placeholder ("ValveTestApp50620") and it shows no price history. The Warmastered schema calls the app "Darksiders Definitive Edition". RAWG's entry is the original 2010 game (id 4502). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 1, but no walkthrough is written: the only subpages are Achievements and trophies (about 6,500 characters), Characters (about 900), Enemies (about 430), Table of Contents (about 410) and Bosses (about 230). So it was not recorded in sw-structure.json and swUsed is off. darksiders.fandom.com answers the API, with about 53 linked pages, including the bosses and weapons the achievements name; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 2 of 43 Steam achievements are hidden ("Treasure Hunter" and "Ultimate Blade"); their names suggest collectibles rather than story, but they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. RAWG lists a playtime of only 3 hours, which looks low. "BFA" ("Unlocked EVERYTHING!") was put in Collectibles and Upgrades.
